landing.title: AI-Powered Space Debris Risk Detection
landing.description: A cinematic 3D orbital system backed by a real collision-risk engine. Live vector telemetry drives on-screen alerts and satellite failure behavior.
landing.footer: WebSocket telemetry • FastAPI • R3F • Physically believable motion

problem.title: The debris problem is accelerating.
problem.p1: Every launch, fragmentation event, and collision multiplies the number of tracked objects. In low Earth orbit, relative velocities are so extreme that even small fragments can disable satellites instantly — risking chain reactions known as the Kessler Syndrome.
problem.v1Body: More satellites, more launches, more fragmentation. The risk surface expands faster than manual monitoring can keep up.
problem.v2Body: Collisions generate debris that causes more collisions — a cascade that can make key orbits unusable for decades.
problem.v3Body: Orbital objects can close at ~7–14 km/s. A small bolt carries the destructive energy of a high-speed projectile.
problem.aiBody: We compute collision probability in real time and push warnings directly into the orbital visualization.

orbit.title: Live orbit + collision telemetry
orbit.desc: Technical view. Streams multi-object state to the backend and renders velocity vectors, orbit paths, and closest-approach highlighting. Camera is fully movable.

ai.title: Explainable collision risk — computed automatically
ai.desc: This page is a readable AI dashboard (not a JSON playground). It shows the selected satellite/debris pair, live computed values, dominant factors, and confidence rationale — updated continuously from WebSocket telemetry.
ai.streamingModeDesc: Streaming mode: orbit/scenario pages can publish synthetic states, but your backend also broadcasts real TLE propagation every ~2s.

scenario.title: Mission Decision-Support
scenario.desc: Hypothetical scenario modeling with instantaneous risk assessment, collision previews, and maneuver generation.

notes.NOTE_CLOSEST_OUTSIDE: Closest approach is outside the scenario threshold; risk decays quickly.
notes.NOTE_ALT_DIFF: Large altitude difference makes an encounter less plausible (risk reduced).
notes.NOTE_FAR_TIME: Approach is far in time; uncertainty dominates the scenario.
